author: Laura Nahmias, Nacha Cattan
description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has thrown down an ultimatum, threatening to raise property taxes by nearly 10% as a way to lobby Governor Kathy Hochul for more funding.
title: Mamdani Threatens NYC Property Tax Hike as Last-Resort Option

author: Joe Deaux, Annmarie Hordern
description: The US has developed a critical minerals price floor system that it’s pitching to allies as the Trump administration and more than 50 countries look to reduce dependence on China for the resources that are deemed critical to national security.
title: US Agencies Have Developed Critical Minerals Price Floor System

author: Eliyahu Kamisher, Biz Carson
description: Sergey Brin and a group of fellow billionaires are bankrolling a series of competing California ballot initiatives that would nullify a proposed 5% levy on the state’s wealthiest residents.
title: Sergey Brin-Backed PAC Pushes to Counter California Billionaire Tax

description: The Justice Department’s largest release yet of the Epstein files shows that Jeffrey Epstein was Leon Black’s stealthy do-it-all fixer. Beyond mere estate planning, the convicted sex offender arranged family portraits, helped the billionaire co-founder of Apollo Global Management leverage up a vast art collection, dug into his investment in the storied publishing house Phaidon and obscured some of his most sensitive secrets. Bloomberg News Finance Reporter Max Abelson joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss. He speaks with Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Epstein Was Fixer for Leon Black's Deepest Secrets

description: Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi (D-IL) states President Trump doesn’t respect the War Powers Act when discussing if he thinks Congress will be warned if Trump attacks Iran again. He voices his frustration with the President’s foreign policy and discusses what’s next for Congress & DHS reforms as the government is partially shutdown. Rep. Krishnmaoorthi speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg’s “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Doesn't Respect War Powers Act: Rep. Krishnamoorthi

author: Iain Marlow
description: President’s representatives have Iran, Ukraine and Gaza in porfolios.
title: Trump’s Trusted Envoys, Kushner and Witkoff, Handle a Trio of Crises

description: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec discuss Apple reportedly accelerating work on glasses, a pendant device, and AirPods as part of a larger AI-focused shift. Bloomberg News Managing Editor for Global Consumer Tech Mark Gurman joins the show to discuss. Plus, Bloomberg News Tech & National Security Reporter News Tech & National Security Reporter Katrina Manson joins to discuss Anthropic's Pentagon talks snagging on AI surveillance and weapons concerns. Then, Bloomberg's Annmarie Hordern sits down with Blue Origin CEO David Limp at the Inaugural Defense Tech Leadership Summit. Finally, Telsey Advisory Group CEO Dana Telsey weighs in on the state of the US consumer ahead of Walmart earnings Thursday. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Apple Ramps Up Wearables for AI Era | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 2/17/2026

author: Annie Massa
description: Eric Trump is backing a drone company, adding to his family’s defense portfolio at a moment when his father’s administration is bolstering the industry.
title: Eric Trump Backs Drone Company, Adding to Family’s Defense Ties

author: Laura Benitez
description: Teachers unions are asking the US Securities & Exchange Commission to consider whether a 2021 statement from Apollo Global Management Inc. about the extent of its contact with late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein could be considered materially false or misleading.
title: Teachers Unions Ask SEC to Scrutinize Apollo’s Epstein Ties

description: Prediction market platforms operate exchanges that allow customers to bet on the outcome of a wide range of future events, from presidential elections to college basketball games. The CFTC said recently it would craft new rules for the multi-billion dollar industry. Its chair Mike Selig over the past week has the made the case on why the commission should regulate prediction markets, including on Tuesday, when he said the CFTC filed a friend-of-the-court brief in cases regarding states seeking to block prediction markets. Bloomberg Intelligence's Nathan Dean reports on "Bloomberg Crypto." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: 'See You in Court', CFTC Chair Sides with Prediction Markets

description: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss the ongoing shutdown at the Department of Homeland Security. On today's show, Arizona State University McCain Institute Executive Director Evelyn Farkas, Harvard Kennedy School's Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino, S-3 Group Partner Ashley Davis and Democratic Congresswoman Dina Titus of Nevada. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US, Iran Hail Progress in Nuclear Talks | Balance of Power: Early Edition 2/17/2026

author: Josh Wingrove, Yoshiaki Nohara
description: The US and Japan unveiled the debut projects of a $550 billion investment fund, pressing ahead with a trade and economic pact in the weeks before Japan’s Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is set to meet US President Donald Trump.
title: Trump Announces First Japan Investments Under Trade Deal

description: David Limp, CEO of Blue Origin, says that the company is focused 'lunar permanence,' aiming to send people to the moon and keep them there for a prolonged period of time. Speaking to Bloomberg's Annmarie Hordern at the Defense Tech Leadership Summit, Limp breaks down the technological advancements necessary to reach that goal and sheds light on Blue Origin's relationship with NASA and the US government.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Blue Origin Focused on 'Lunar Permanence' Says CEO Limp

author: Isabelle Lee, Denitsa Tsekova
description: Roundhill Investments has asked the US Securities and Exchange Commission for permission to launch six ETFs that would let investors wager on US election outcomes through standard brokerage accounts — the most ambitious attempt yet to bring prediction markets into mainstream finance.
title: Wall Street Wants to Bring Election Bets Into Brokerage Accounts

description: Evelyn Farkas, executive director of the McCain Institute, says despite positive talks in Geneva, Iran and the United States remain 'dug in' on positions around nuclear capabilities. However, Iran's willingness to come to the table could complicate President Trump's relationship with his base if he does decide to strike Iran. Farkas also discussed the talks between Russia and Ukraine, saying that Russia will continue to disappoint at the negotiating table.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US, Iran Hail Progress in Nuclear Talks After Trump Threats

author: Marcelo Rochabrun, Matthew Bristow
description: Peru’s President José Jerí was ousted by congress after just four months in office, adding to a saga of political instability that’s seen eight leaders pass through office since 2016.
title: Peru’s Congress Removes President Jerí After Four Months in Office

author: Mikella Schuettler
description: A former top Justice Department official said his social media call encouraging lawyers who “support President Trump” to apply for federal prosecutor jobs drew a big response.
title: Ex-Bondi Aide Says MAGA Prosecutor Pitch Got About 1,000 Resumes

description: Democratic Representative Dina Titus on Nevada said that in the standoff over DHS funding, the public backs the Democrats' position that immigration agents should be subject to the same rules as regular law enforcement officers. Titus also discussed her bill aimed at stopping prediction markets from skirting gaming laws, saying that if the markets move into sports betting they need to follow the same rules as other betting platforms.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Dems, GOP Locked in Standoff Over ICE Reform, DHS Funding

author: Piotr Bujnicki
description: Poland has banned Chinese-made cars from entering military facilities in an effort to bolster infrastructure security, according to the country’s General Staff.
title: Poland Bars Chinese-Made Cars From Army Sites Over Data Fears

author: Anthony Capaccio
description: RTX Corp. has improved its capability to deliver a key missile for the US Navy but the company’s performance remains below expectations, according to a Pentagon assessment that comes after President Donald Trump singled out the defense contractor in a broader assault on the sector.
title: Pentagon Says RTX Improves ‘Poor’ Performance on Crucial Missile

author: Laura Nahmias
description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani is proposing raising New York City’s property taxes for the first time in more than two decades and is looking to raid the city’s reserve funds to fill a roughly $5 billion budget gap.
title: Mamdani Plans to Hike NYC Property Tax to Fill Budget Hole

author: Max Ramsay
description: The European Union extended an arms embargo on Zimbabwe by a year — until February 2027 — as part of an annual review of sanctions it imposed against the southern African nation.
title: EU Extends Zimbabwe Arms Embargo by One Year in Sanctions Review

author: Alex Wickham, Ellen Milligan, Lucy White, Jorge Valero
description: The UK is lobbying countries including Germany, Italy and the Netherlands to push back against strict French trade proposals that would exclude Britain from participating in public procurement bids.
title: UK Seeks EU Allies to Help Oppose France’s ‘Made in Europe’ Push

author: Anthony Capaccio
description: The US Air Force said it intends to complete by the end of the year a restructuring plan for the new Sentinel intercontinental ballistic missile system from Northrop Grumman Corp., after the projected $141 billion program was plagued by skyrocketing costs and fielding delays.
title: Air Force Says New ICBM Plan Will Be Done by End of Year

description: Iran said it reached a “general agreement” with the US on the basis of a potential nuclear deal that would lift sanctions on Tehran and ease the risk of war in the Middle East. Tyler Kendall has more from Washington. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iran, US Reach 'Principles' of New Nuclear Deal

author: Caitlin Reilly
description: Average tax refunds increased more than $200 in the first two weeks of filing season compared to the same time last year, as Republicans pin their midterm pitch to voters on delivering big tax savings.
title: Average Tax Refunds Up More than $200 as Filing Season Opens

author: Laura Dhillon Kane, Mathieu Dion
description: Prime Minister Mark Carney said Canada will invest hundreds of billions of dollars in defense over the next decade as part of a strategy to steer more of that spending to domestic firms rather than US contractors.
title: Carney Promises Billions for Canada Military Gear in Pivot from US

author: Iain Rogers
description: The Alternative for Germany (AfD) has for the first time been classified as right-wing extremist by a federal state in the west of the country, giving authorities there enhanced powers to monitor the party as a potential threat to democracy.
title: German AfD Party Labeled Right-Wing Extremist by Western Region

author: Joe Lovinger
description: In more than two decades as a US Senator from Texas, John Cornyn has never faced a serious electoral threat. This year, he’s struggling to make it past the Republican primary.
title: Cornyn Struggles in Texas GOP Primary as Democrats Eye His Seat

author: Molly Smith
description: A statistical advocacy group is calling on Congress to exempt data agency personnel from a new rule that will reclassify thousands of federal workers into “policy-influencing” positions.
title: Congress Urged to Exempt Data Agencies From Policy Career Change

author: Catherine Lucey
description: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer signaled that the Trump administration is open to changing how its broad tariffs on steel and aluminum are enforced amid pressure from business groups and trading partners.
title: US Open to Metals Tariff Enforcement Adjustments, Greer Says

author: Donato Paolo Mancini
description: Italy will be an observer on President Donald Trump’s Gaza peace board in Washington Thursday, after ruling out full participation due to legal concerns.
title: Italy to Be an Observer On Trump’s Board of Peace, Minister Says

author: Daryna Krasnolutska
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said he tasked his country’s negotiators to discuss the future of the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant, which Russian forces seized early in the full-scale invasion, during peace talks in Geneva.
title: Ukraine to Discuss Nuclear Plant With Russia, Zelenskiy Says

author: Mehboob Jeelani
description: India’s biggest business summit in years descended into chaos this week after hundreds of delegates were left stranded without food or water during a sudden security lockdown, a black eye for a marquee gathering that was supposed to trumpet the country’s AI ascendancy.
title: India’s Big AI Moment Starts on Chaotic Note

author: Alberto Nardelli, Andrea Palasciano, Donato Paolo Mancini
description: The European Union’s attempt to penalize foreign ports and banks that Russia uses to illicitly sell oil is running into opposition, threatening to weaken the bloc’s latest sanctions package.
title: EU Countries’ Resistance Risks Blunting Latest Russia Sanctions

author: Andras Gergely
description: Hungary’s bonds extended gains after the latest US pledge of financial support for Prime Minister Viktor Orban, raising new questions about the sustainability of the rally, according to asset manager Aviva Investors.
title: Hungary’s Bonds Look Frothy After Rubio Pledge, Aviva Says

author: Matthew Bristow
description: US demands to hunt down and extradite warlords threaten to unleash more violence before May’s vote
title: Colombian Candidates Retreat as Violence Shakes 2026 Election

author: Matthew Bristow
description: EE.UU. exige capturar y extraditar a los jefes de la guerra, lo que amenaza con desatar más violencia antes de las elecciones de mayo.
title: Violencia y narcotráfico amenazan elecciones presidenciales en Colombia

author: Lucy White
description: Nigel Farage said Robert Jenrick is Reform UK’s pick for Chancellor of the Exchequer should his poll-leading party win the next general election.
title: Farage Reveals Robert Jenrick as Reform UK’s Chancellor Pick

author: Patrick Sykes, Arsalan Shahla
description: The US and Iran made progress in nuclear talks in Geneva on Tuesday, with Tehran’s negotiators scheduled to return with a new proposal in two weeks, a US official said on Tuesday, a cautiously upbeat assessment that suggests the chances of an imminent military clash are low.
title: US, Iran Hail Progress in Nuclear Talks After Trump Threats

author: Ania Nussbaum, Sudhi Ranjan Sen
description: French President Emmanuel Macron pushed for closer economic ties with India to protect against global uncertainty, pulling out all the stops during his high profile visit to the country to persuade Prime Minister Narendra Modi to buy fighter jets.
title: Macron Hails India Ties as He Pushes Fighter Jet Deal With Modi
